label: Eve alt — assassin torso + eve legs
_rigIdNote: Composed characters declare a rigId so the engine knows which logicalGroups (top/bottom) apply. Both parts must share the same rigId — composer rejects cross-rig composition (e.g. mixamo top + biped bottom) since clip retargeting is out of scope for Phase 3.

connection._alignmentNote: Vertical offset added to the top's anchor world position so chest sits at the right height on the bottom's hip. Tuned by tools/rig_compose.html.

boneNamespace._namespaceNote: Prefix added to colliding bone names. e.g. both parts may export 'Bip001-Spine' — the composer renames top's to 'T_Bip001-Spine' and bottom's to 'B_Bip001-Spine' to avoid lookup collisions in the merged skeleton. Bones above hip in the bottom part and bones below hip in the top part are dropped before namespacing.
